_comment: Hand-authored. Bank 6 $8A9A-$8BEE: weapons 9-12 and the enemy-erasing routine. The generators subtract these.

regions.name: WEAPON 9 HYPER LASER (corridors only), set-up: the beam's parent
regions.description: `$0668,X` := 0 (the parent slot, the player) and `$0680,X` := `$81` (the parent's type): the beam is drawn between this object and the ship by the beam routine `$FB76` (see the beam entry) and ends when the ship is not that type any more.

regions.name: WEAPON 9 HYPER LASER (corridors only), speed, tile base, style
regions.description: `$05D8,X` := `$8ADD[level]` (the y speed: -6, -10, -8 px a frame), `$06C8,X` := `$8AE0[level]`; the style index `$8AE3[level]` (0, 3, 6) is pushed. RUN: set-up of the object on the labyrinth savestate with `$30` bit 6 set.

regions.name: WEAPON 9 HYPER LASER (corridors only), the beam's look
regions.description: `TXA / TAY / PLA`, `JSR $C13B` (`$FDF8`): the style index selects a 3-byte record in `$FE22` that sets the metasprite (`$00`, `$1A`, `$17`), `$0638` (`$40`, `$60`, `$F0`) and the half-width `$0650` (3, 8, 24 px); it also sets drawing flags 0, palette 0, hit points `$FF` and attack **1**. RUN: exactly these values at levels 1-3.

regions.name: WEAPON 9 HYPER LASER (corridors only), drawing flags
WEAPON 9 HYPER LASER (corridors only), start position
WEAPON 9, every frame: run the beam
regions.description: `JSR $C129` (`$FB76`, the beam machine of the helper entry); carry set (the ship is gone) removes the beam at `$8AF5`. RUN: with slot 0 not `$81` the beam was removed.

regions.name: Weapon 9: when does it hurt?
regions.description: `$0578,X` := 8 (no collision with ordinary enemies, whose mask is `$30`); then the level's frame mask `$8AE6[level]` AND the frame counter `$41`: non-zero leaves it at 8, zero sets `$8AE9[level]` = `$18`, `$38`, `$3C`. So level 1 hurts on every other frame (`$41` bit 0 clear), levels 2 and 3 on every frame with wider masks. RUN: level 1 flags 18 08 18 08 for `$41` = 0..3; levels 2 and 3 `38` / `3C` throughout. The `RTS` at `$8ADD` is also the byte `$60` that the tables' bases count from.

regions.name: Hyper Laser y speed by level
regions.description: `FA F6 F8` (-6, -10, -8 px a frame); read at `$8ADD + level`.

regions.name: Hyper Laser tile base by level
regions.description: `76 76 02`; read at `$8AE0 + level`.

regions.name: Hyper Laser style record by level
regions.description: `00 03 06`: the offset of the level's 3-byte record in `$FE22`; read at `$8AE3 + level`.

regions.name: Hyper Laser frame mask by level
regions.description: `01 00 00`; read at `$8AE6 + level`.

regions.name: Hyper Laser collision flags by level
regions.description: `18 38 3C`; read at `$8AE9 + level`.

regions.name: WEAPONS 10 SABER LASER and 11 CUTTER LASER (blades while A is held): is A held?
regions.description: `$F7 OR $F8` bit 7 (A held): if not, the blade is removed (`$8AF5`). RUN: releasing A removed it.

regions.name: Remove this object
WEAPONS 10 SABER LASER and 11 CUTTER LASER (blades while A is held): position
regions.description: x, y := the player's.

regions.name: WEAPONS 10 SABER LASER and 11 CUTTER LASER (blades while A is held): facing
regions.description: A := the player's `$0668`, through `$87E4` (forced to 12, up, in a corridor); Y := A.

regions.name: WEAPONS 10 SABER LASER and 11 CUTTER LASER (blades while A is held): which direction this blade takes
regions.description: Weapon 10 (Saber): the facing itself. Weapon 11 (Cutter): minus 4 for slot 3, minus 4 plus 7 plus the carry (8) for slot 4: the two blades sit 90 degrees either side of the facing. RUN: facing 12 gave offsets (-16, 0) and (16, 0), facing 0 gave (0, -16) and (0, 16).

regions.name: WEAPONS 10 SABER LASER and 11 CUTTER LASER (blades while A is held): the offset
regions.description: `$18` (y) := `$8B6F[Y]`, `$19` (x) := `$8B73[Y]`: a sine and cosine of radius 16.

regions.name: WEAPONS 10 SABER LASER and 11 CUTTER LASER (blades while A is held): alternate frames
regions.description: `$41` bit 0 set doubles both (radius 32). RUN: facing 4 gave (0, 16) and (0, 32) on even and odd frames.

regions.name: WEAPONS 10 SABER LASER and 11 CUTTER LASER (blades while A is held): corridor adjustment
regions.description: In a corridor with direction 12 the y offset is lowered by 8 more. RUN: -24.

regions.name: WEAPONS 10 SABER LASER and 11 CUTTER LASER (blades while A is held): picture
regions.description: Y / 2 AND 3 picks the metasprite `$8B83`, the tile base `$8B87` and a flip / palette `$8B8B`, merged into `$0560,X`.

regions.name: WEAPONS 10 SABER LASER and 11 CUTTER LASER (blades while A is held): attack
regions.description: `$05A8,X` := the player's attack x 2, 4, 8 at levels 1-3, then `JMP $88C7` (collide at the offset with the orbit helper). RUN: a player attack of 5 gave 10, 20, 40.

regions.name: Blade offsets: a sine of 16 entries, read at two phases
regions.description: `00 06 0B 0F 10 0F 0B 06 00 FA F5 F1 F0 F1 F5 FA` (radius 16) read at `$8B6F + direction` for y and at `$8B73 + direction` for x (the same wave four steps on, so the last four bytes `00 06 0B 0F` complete the cosine).

regions.name: Blade metasprites by phase
Blade tile bases by phase
Blade palette / flip by phase
Spend chips (called by `$8606`)
regions.description: A chips are subtracted from `$4C/$4D` (borrow into the high byte), then `JMP $C05A` (`$E213`: the gun tier and the chip counter).

regions.name: WEAPON 12 ENEMY ERASER: A pressed?
regions.description: Needs a NEW A press (`$F5 OR $F6` bit 7); otherwise the object is removed without effect (`$8BCB`). RUN: no press left the enemies and the stock alone.

regions.name: WEAPON 12 ENEMY ERASER: flash
regions.description: Sound `$2F`, then `JSR $C0CC` (`$D33F`) with A = `$30`: the backdrop colour `$0180` := `$30` (white) and a palette upload `$017F` := 3; sound `$2F` again.

regions.name: WEAPON 12 ENEMY ERASER: wait
regions.description: `JSR $C021` (`$FFD1`) waits 6 frames. RUN: 6 frames.

regions.name: WEAPON 12 ENEMY ERASER: erase
regions.description: `JSR $8BCE`: every erasable enemy becomes an explosion (below).

regions.name: WEAPON 12 ENEMY ERASER: back to black
regions.description: The backdrop := `$0F` through `$C0CC`.

regions.name: WEAPON 12 ENEMY ERASER: the cost
regions.description: `$04AF` (the stock) and `$3E` (uses left) decremented, the uses-left HUD printed. RUN: 5 -> 4 and 5 -> 4.

regions.name: WEAPON 12 ENEMY ERASER: remove the weapon object
ERASE THE ENEMIES (slot `$8003`; the Eraser, and bank 3 `$935A` in the boss-defeat sequence)
regions.description: Slots 5 to 23: an initialised object (type bit 7 set) whose collision flags `$0578` bit 6 is clear has its type (without bit 7) saved in `$0740,Y` and becomes type 8, an explosion. The saved type is what the explosion handler uses for the item-box counter (see the item box entry). Objects with `$0578` bit 6 set (the bosses and the stage's fixed targets) are immune. RUN: slots with types `$9A`, `$A1` became 8 and remembered `$1A`, `$21`; an immune slot and an uninitialised one stayed. **CORRECTION / answer:** bank 6 slot `$8003` was recorded as unread; it is this routine.
